_comment: CURRENT STATE: all scripts read/write model/ directly (flat, single version) — that's what's actually running today, described honestly below. The 'recommended_layout_for_hot_swap' block is the small refactor to do BEFORE adding a second (e.g. MIMIC-IV) model version: move model/ contents into model/<version_name>/, then have the serving app read this file to pick which subfolder is active. That change is what makes 'swap model, restart, no redeploy' actually true — see README 'Cloud Deployment & MIMIC Hot-Swap Design' for the exact steps.

physionet_sepsis_challenge_v1.notes: Sepsis label adjudicated by challenge organizers. ARF/Cardiac/AKI/Coagulopathy are rule-based clinical proxies (see 01_etl_pipeline.py) — not adjudicated ground truth. Files live directly in model/ (current_model_dir above).

physionet_sepsis_challenge_v1_publicatio.ensemble: soft voting: p = alpha * p_xgb + (1-alpha) * p_rf, alpha tuned on validation
physionet_sepsis_challenge_v1_publicatio.evaluation: bootstrap 95% CIs, Brier score, calibration slope/intercept, DCA, patient-level metrics
physionet_sepsis_challenge_v1_publicatio.notes: Publication-quality version with methodological fixes. Uses ensemble_models.pkl instead of production_models.pkl when available. Proxy label disclaimer applies to ARF/Cardiac/AKI/Coagulopathy.

mimic_iv_v1.notes: Once trained: ARF from icd_code J96.*, cardiac arrest from I46.*, AKI from N17.* (real diagnoses, replacing this version's proxy labels). Sepsis from Sepsis-3 criteria applied to MIMIC vitals+labs, or icd_code A41.*/R65.2* as a secondary check. Would live in model/mimic_iv_v1/ once the versioned layout is adopted.

recommended_layout_for_hot_swap.step_1: mkdir -p model/physionet_sepsis_challenge_v1 && mv model/*.pkl model/*.json model/*.pt model/*.npz model/physionet_sepsis_challenge_v1/  (keep this file, model_registry.json, at the repo root)
recommended_layout_for_hot_swap.step_2: Point every script's MODEL_DIR at model/<active_version>/ by reading active_version from this file instead of a hardcoded 'model' string — a ~10-line change in each script (BASE_DIR / 'model' / registry['active_version']).
recommended_layout_for_hot_swap.step_3: Train the MIMIC model with the same scripts (01 -> 02 -> 05 -> 03 -> 04), pointed at MIMIC-mapped data, writing to model/mimic_iv_v1/.
recommended_layout_for_hot_swap.step_4: Flip active_version to 'mimic_iv_v1' in this file, restart the app process. If model/ is a mounted volume (not baked into the container image), this requires zero image rebuild and zero redeploy — just a process restart.
recommended_layout_for_hot_swap.why_not_done_already: Doing this refactor before there's a second model version to swap to would just be speculative complexity in a repo that's still being iterated on. The one-time cost is small (~10 lines/script) and is the very next thing to do once MIMIC access exists.
